snippet.title: God of War Sons of Sparta - Symphony of Sparta | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
Available on PS5® today! 
Purchase Now or Learn More: https://www.playstation.com/en-us/games/god-of-war-sons-of-sparta/

Bear McCreary returns as the composer for God of War Sons of Sparta! 

Melding retro aesthetics with God of War’s signature sweeping orchestral and choral style, Bear McCreary dives into how the sound of Sons of Sparta came to be.  

#ps5 #ps5games
